svg.text: Net-label schematic: points that carry the same net name are connected. [A] marks an assumption to confirm against the build.

Current channels (SCT-013 100 A / 50 mA, one per phase)
J1 3.5 mm: sleeve = bias node, tip = AIN0 [A]
J2 3.5 mm: sleeve = bias node, tip = AIN1 [A]
J3 3.5 mm: sleeve = bias node, tip = AIN2 [A]
The ZMPT101B isolates its output from its AC input.
L1, L2, L3 and N are the panel busbars.
Contactor coil circuit (existing panel, see panel-illustration)
Relay contact COM-NO is in series with the K1 coil.
Trip or loss of power = contact opens, K1 drops out.
Manual reset required after every trip.
1. +5V is the fused ATX rail (1 A fuse F1).
limit is 3.3 V: headroom not yet checked.

on a live conductor. Isolate before connecting.
